diagrams.title: CourseHub Data Model
diagrams.description: Entity Relationship Diagram showing the core data structures for users, courses, and enrollments.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    ENT-USER ||--o{ ENT-COURSE : "instructs"
    ENT-USER ||--o{ ENT-ENROLL : "enrolls"
    ENT-COURSE ||--o{ ENT-ENROLL : "has"
    ENT-COURSE ||--o{ MODULE : "contains"

    ENT-USER {
        int id PK
        string email
        string hashed_password
        string role
    }
    ENT-COURSE {
        int id PK
        int instructor_id FK
        string title
        int price_cents
        boolean published
    }
    ENT-ENROLL {
        int id PK
        int student_id FK
        int course_id FK
        int progress
    }
    MODULE {
        int id PK
        int course_id FK
        string title
        int order
    }

diagrams.title: Course Deletion Workflow
diagrams.description: Detailed logic for the Course Deletion process implementing the ActiveEnrollmentConstraint business rule.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    START[Start Delete Request] --> AUTH_CHECK{"Is User Instructor?"}
    AUTH_CHECK -- "No" --> ERR_403["Return 403 Forbidden"]
    AUTH_CHECK -- "Yes" --> OWN_CHECK{"Does User own Course?"}
    
    OWN_CHECK -- "No" --> ERR_403
    OWN_CHECK -- "Yes" --> ENROLL_CHECK{"Any Active Enrollments?"}
    
    ENROLL_CHECK -- "Yes" --> RULE_409["RULE-ACTIVE-ENROLL: Return 409 Conflict"]
    ENROLL_CHECK -- "No" --> DEL_EXEC[Execute Cascading Delete]
    
    ERR_403 --> END[End]
    RULE_409 --> END
    DEL_EXEC --> END

diagrams.title: User Registration & Email Sequence
diagrams.description: Sequence of interactions for user registration, highlighting the non-blocking background email task.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Student
    participant API as "EP-AUTH-REG: Auth Router"
    participant DB as "PostgreSQL"
    participant BG as "FastAPI BackgroundTask"
    participant Email as "EMAIL-BG: Resend Service"

    Student ->> API: POST /api/v1/auth/register
    API ->> DB: Create User (role=student)
    DB -->> API: User Created
    API ->> BG: add_task(send_welcome_email_async)
    API -->> Student: Return 201 Created + JWT Tokens
    
    Note over BG, Email: Asynchronous Execution
    BG ->> Email: Trigger Welcome Email
    Email ->> Student: Send Email via Resend SDK
